messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: anomaly detected — embedder 'embed-v2' in eu-west1 showing 18% drop in average cosine similarity for key enterprise customers starting ~2198765400. Auto-alert routed to #incidents and paged oncall.
sophie-ng: saw this. loading the eval dashboards now. looks like a sharp delta in shorter texts < 64 tokens.
mike-h: oncall here. paging in @leo-ml for model/quality signoff. I'm going to check recent deploys and routing.
leo-ml: looking — there was a canary deploy of embed-v2 at 2198764950 that escalated to all in eu-west1 at 2198765120. rolling metrics show a regression in similarity and higher false-neg rates.
sophie-ng: can we quickly route eu-west1 traffic to embed-v1 to stop new errors while we investigate? need to limit customer impact.
oncall-night: routing change can be done via runtime: `redwood route set --region eu-west1 --model embed-v1 --selector embed-service` — I'll run it if we agree.
mike-h: +1 do it. keep canary pinned until we confirm root cause. @deploy-bot can we get an automated rollback for the canary timestamp? we need a safe rollback that doesn't touch other regions.
deploy-bot: Rollback job queued: `rollback-deploy --service embed-service --region eu-west1 --to-timestamp 2198764940`. ETA ~45s.
leo-ml: starting quick diff between embed-v1 and embed-v2 tokenization and preproc flags. suspect token truncation change in the new tokenizer patch.
sophie-ng: status page draft — keeping short. putting a draft below, please edit inline:

```
Status: Degraded performance for embedding service in eu-west1
Impact: Some customers may see lower quality on short inputs starting 2026-03-15 ~09:30 UTC
Mitigation: Traffic routed to a previous model variant; engineering investigation in progress
Next update: in 30 minutes or earlier
```

mike-h: good. add "no data exfiltration" and "no impact to other regions" lines.
emily-cs: prepping a customer-facing note for affected enterprise tenants. Draft suggestion:

"We are investigating a temporary degradation in embedding quality for short inputs in our eu-west1 region. We have routed traffic to a stable model variant and are monitoring. No action is required on your side; we will follow up with a timeline and any needed remediation steps." :handshake:

julie-pm: suggest adding an ETA for a postmortem and a contact for priority customers (support+severe flag).
leo-ml: quick check results: tokenization mismatch confirmed — a dependency bumped upstream changed `max_prefix` handling. reproducer attached below.
sophie-ng: adding reproducer snippet to thread for ops:

```
# minimal repro
input = "customer short query"
vec_v1 = embed_model('embed-v1', input)
vec_v2 = embed_model('embed-v2', input)
cos_sim(vec_v1, vec_v2)  # 0.62 expected >0.95
```

mike-h: rollback completed per deploy-bot. runtime routing confirmed to embed-v1. monitoring shows similarity creeping back up within 3 minutes.
oncall-night: verified via `rtr status --region eu-west1 --service embed-service` output: active model embed-v1. :white_check_mark:
leo-ml: leaving notes in the model onboarding PR to pin tokenizer dep until we cut a compatibility patch.
julie-pm: drafting incident update and customer email. will paste final texts here for review.
emily-cs: customer email template (short):

"Hi — We detected a temporary degradation affecting embeddings for short inputs in eu-west1. We have rolled back to a stable model and are monitoring. If you see any ongoing issues please contact support@redwood.ai and mention incident #2198765432. We apologize for the disruption."

sophie-ng: internal postmortem stub (for now):
- timeline of events
- root cause: tokenizer dependency bump
- scope/impact: eu-west1 embed-v2 only; estimated % of customers impacted
- mitigation: rollback + routing
- next steps: patch tokenizer, add auto-smoke tests for short inputs, backfill pinned deps in model manifests

mike-h: handing off follow-up to @oncall-night for the 03:00UTC bridge. I'll be offline in 20m. please escalate if metrics slip back.
oncall-night: ack — I'll own ongoing comms, monitoring, and the 30m update. creating an incident channel thread and bridge.
incident-bot: NOTE: Incident channel created: #incident-2198765432. Pager duty Handoff recorded.
sophie-ng: thanks team. save any logs to incident doc and tag `incident-2198765432` in PRs.
leo-ml: I'll open the PR to pin the tokenizer and include a compatibility test. linking it here once ready.
julie-pm: will send customer-notify once emily finishes formatting. target: 15 minutes.
emily-cs: sending the first round of notifications to the 4 impacted enterprise contacts now. cc: support, account leads. :email:
mike-h: nice work. closing active page for now — stay in channel until metrics stable for 1h.
oncall-night: will update status page with the fixed language in 5m and post a final update at 30m. handing off to @leo-ml for follow-up on the code patch.
leo-ml: taking it. starting bisect PR now. will post link when ready.
